rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; Discovery (HCP) cohort harmonized across 4 sites (HCP-YA site + 3 HCP-Psychosis sites: Brigham and Women's Hospital, Indiana Hospital, McLean Hospital); Validation (ASRB) cohort comprised 5 sites (Sydney, Melbourne, Perth, Brisbane, Newcastle)
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "For HCP (discovery), each measure was harmonized across 4 sites: HCP-young adult sample (site 1) and 3 sites comprising the HCP-Psychosis dataset. For ASRB (validation), each measure was harmonized across 5 sites comprising the ASRB dataset."
rci1_using_msad.location: 41380_2022_1460_MOESM1_ESM.pdf.md: MRI acquisition, processing, and harmonization / Harmonization, L96

rci2_using_epd.detail: HCP-Young Adult (HCP-1200) and HCP for Early Psychosis healthy controls used in the discovery reference cohort; ASRB (validation) is an in-house dataset not in the EPD list
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "This study comprised a total of 1849 participants drawn from three independent datasets: (1) the Human Connectome Project-Young Adult Sample [15]; (2) the Human Connectome Project for Early Psychosis (HCPpsychosis) [16]; and (3) the Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank (ASRB) [17]."

rci3_epd_name.detail: HCP-Young Adult (HCP-1200, n=1065 HC) and HCP for Early Psychosis (n=62 HC) used for discovery normative model; both are subsets of the Human Connectome Project; ASRB is not in the EPD list
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "the Human Connectome Project-Young Adult Sample [15]; (2) the Human Connectome Project for Early Psychosis (HCPpsychosis) [16]"

rci5_n.detail: Training phase HC; Discovery model used HCP-Psychosis HC (n=62) + HCP-1200 HC (n=1065) = 1127; Validation model used ASRB HC (n=185); separate normative models built for each cohort
rci5_n.supporting_text: "normative ranges were established based on healthy individuals (n = 1127 for HCP [discovery] and n = 185 for ASRB [validation])"
